thread:
Ava: Quick quarterly OKR check-in — async round. Drop what *shipped*, what *slipped*, owner, deps, and any CR numbers. I'll compile into the milestone doc. Targets to cover: runtime-v2, Dedicated autoscale, Private pilot, Console telemetry retention, Optimize suggestions. Ping owners if you're not here.

Sam: runtime-v2 — shipped canary to prod in eu-west, us-west, us-east. Latency 95p at target. Rolling to full prod next week. CR: #4129 (perf), #4130 (docs). Owner: Sam.

Priya: Dedicated autoscale — slipped. We hit quota ceiling on reserved GPUs after test load; cloud quota request stalled. ETA +2w for quota approval. Owner: Priya. Blocker: cloud quota + eng-infra triage.

Diego: Private pilot — initial VPC onboarding completed for PilotCo, but observed intermittent auth failures during load tests. Not shipped to more pilots until stability fix. Owner: Diego. Ops note: raising an incident if not stable by EOD tomorrow.

Marta: Console telemetry — partial ship: basic dashboards live, retention pipeline not yet. PR 998 is waiting for review (adds 90d retention toggles). Slipped 3 days due to infra schema change. Need @Sam to review the query perf regression.

Sam: @Marta looking now, will post review comments in PR. Quick FYI we've seen 15% slower dashboard queries when retention toggles on, may need index change.

Priya: For Dedicated autoscale workaround we can enable burst capacity but that increases cost. Proposed: enable burst for 2 weeks while quota request processes, then revert. Thoughts?

Ava: @Priya agree as a stopgap — please add cost impact estimate to the milestone doc (link: https://notion.redwood/milestones/q2). Keep finance in the loop.

Diego: auth failures traced to intermittent token refresh race. Short patch ready; will land once eng-infra approves rolling restart plan. Patch: 
```
# quick fix: force refresh on 401 during handshake
if resp.status == 401:
  token_store.refresh()
  retry_request()
```
PR 1002.

eng-infra-bot: deploy-plan generated for PR 1002, canary window 30m, requires oncall acknowledgement.

Marta: tagging @Sam @Priya in PR 998 for perf and quota impacts. ETA to merge 48–72h after reviews.

Sam: CR #4129 done, #4130 docs merged. I'll review PR 998 by EOD.

Priya: added burst cost delta and next-actions in the milestone doc. Also listed dependency: quota ticket CLOUD-231.

Ava: Thanks — next steps: I will synthesize these into the OKR checkpoint doc and add owners+ETA. If anyone wants a quick sync call, drop a thumbs. Otherwise I'll do async compile and share by lunchtime tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Diego: quick ask — can eng-infra schedule the 30m canary window tomorrow morning? @eng-infra-bot please loop oncall.

eng-infra-bot: pinging #eng-infra oncall.

Marta: small follow-up: console analytics alerting still TODO — marking as follow-up for next sprint.

Ava: noted. Thanks all — I'll post the compiled snapshot here and update the Notion page.

Sam: thanks, will keep an eye on PRs.

Priya: thanks everyone, will chase CLOUD-231 with Cloud PM.

Diego: good plan, thanks.
